claim: External metacognitive control cuts Confident Failure Rate from 0.600 to 0.143 (76% at temperature 0); giving models their own calibration scores yields no significant improvement (p > 0.05).
stance_target: L3 adjacent: confidence-driven action selection works only with external constraint
scope_conditions: 5 models from 4 labs at T=0.7 mean 70%
quoted_support: Providing models with their own calibration scores produces no significant improvement ( p>0.05 ); only architectural constraint is effective.
